description: This file defines the 'Periodic' class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically handling financial cash flow calculations such as future value, present value, and number of periods for annuities with constant payments. It includes methods for these calculations, input validation, and handles different parameter types consistent with Excel functions.

classes.name: Periodic
classes.description: A class providing static methods for financial cash flow calculations involving periodic payments, including future value, present value, and number of periods, with input validation and flexibility for different payment types.

methods.name: futureValue
methods.description: Calculates the future value of a series of cash flows (annuities) with constant payments and interest rate.

methods.name: presentValue
methods.description: Calculates the present value of a series of cash flows with constant payments and interest rate.

methods.name: periods
methods.description: Calculates the number of periods for a cash flow with constant periodic payments and interest rate.

methods.name: calculateFutureValue
methods.description: Private helper method to compute future value based on validated parameters.

methods.name: calculatePresentValue
methods.description: Private helper method to compute present value based on validated parameters.

methods.name: calculatePeriods
methods.description: Private helper method to compute the number of periods based on validated parameters.
